_comment: Deterministic nudge copy, keyed by nudgeType_interventionLevel.
Placeholders: {task} the task title, {minutes} the block length,
{late} minutes past the planned start, {moves} times already moved.
At least eight variants per key, and the rotation in compose_nudge never
repeats the last two used for a key. Repetition is the fastest route to
being ignored, so this file matters more than it looks.
sessionStart_l0Gentle: You put {minutes} minutes aside for {task}. Go?
sessionMissed_l0Gentle: That {minutes} minute block for {task} is open.
sessionMissed_l1Check: You were going to start {task} {late} minutes ago. Starting, or moving it?
{late} minutes past. Start {task}, or push it?
{task} hasn't started. Begin now or reschedule?
That was {late} minutes ago. Still on for {task}?
{task} is {late} minutes late. Go now, or later?
No start on {task} yet. Now or move it?
{late} minutes in. Do you want {task} now or another time?
Checking in — {task} was due {late} minutes ago.
sessionMissed_l2Diagnose: {task} still hasn't started. What's in the way?
Talk to me — what's holding it up?
Is it the task, or the timing?
What would make {task} easier to start?
sessionMissed_l3Shrink: Forget the whole thing. Give me 10 minutes.
Skip the full block. Just 10 minutes on {task}.
Let's shrink it — 10 minutes and you're done.
sessionMissed_l4Renegotiate: You've moved {task} {moves} times and it's due soon. Twenty minutes now?
That's {moves} moves on {task}. Let's do 20 minutes and cut tonight down.
{task} has slipped {moves} times with the deadline close. 20 minutes?
This is move number {moves}. Give me 20 minutes on {task} now.
{task} keeps sliding and time is short. Twenty minutes?
Moved {moves} times already. Twenty minutes on {task} now saves you later.
Deadline's near and {task} has moved {moves} times. 20 minutes?
Let's stop the slide — 20 minutes on {task}.
sessionMissed_l5Concede: Alright, {task} moves. I'll find a new slot.
Dropping it for now. {task} is moved.
